title: 'forbidden' compiles to a bare node — no nested shape, no example, no arguments.
why: behavioural spec 'forbidden': compiles to a 'forbidden' node (shape spec §4.4), which admits absence and nothing else; it takes no nested shape and no example, so the helper takes no arguments. The node a helper with nothing to carry emits is the whole of what this case pins — an 'of' or an 'example' here would be the SDK inventing a member the operator does not have.

interaction.description: an order that must not carry the customer's tax file number
